Class BuildReportSpy

java.lang.Object
network.ike.tooling.buildreport.BuildReportSpy
All Implemented Interfaces:
org.apache.maven.eventspy.EventSpy
@Named("ike-build-report") @Singleton public class BuildReportSpy extends Object implements org.apache.maven.eventspy.EventSpy
Routes structured build events into ReportSession, which writes the ike꞉build-report.md receipt at session end.

This spy never fails the build and never throws out of onEvent(Object) — a collection error degrades to a log line, not a build problem. Gate enforcement, when armed, is GateKeeper's job at afterSessionEnd; receipt writing is idempotent across the two components, whichever runs first.

Registered through the hand-written sisu index at META-INF/sisu/javax.inject.Named; see the module POM for the EventSpy-vs-new-API rationale.
